title: Campus police says you owe a fine
scenario: A caller claiming to be campus police says a complaint was filed about your online activity and you can avoid a formal disciplinary referral by paying an administrative fine today.

answers.A: End the call and contact campus police/student conduct through official university numbers.
answers.B: Ask for the case number and written notice in your student portal before taking action.
answers.C: Pay if they accept a normal card and send a university-branded receipt.

explanation: Professional payment methods and branding do not authenticate an authority demand. Verify the case in the institution’s own system.
proTip: Real discipline leaves a real institutional trail.
